# Three.js r186 (MIT)

Vendored from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r186 using the original
build and example modules. LICENSE is included. Only the explorer dynamically
imports these files; no CDN or third-party API is contacted during use.

GLTFLoader uses BufferGeometryUtils and SkeletonUtils. RoomEnvironment creates
the studio reflections procedurally; no external HDRI/texture download is needed.
